candidate_crop.method: Compare each removed scanline pixel with the same-x pixel on the nearest retained boundary row. Any difference establishes rendered information that the centered crop discards.

interpretation.supported: A centered 216-line crop is not observationally neutral on canonical Uniracers output and discards rendered image information in representative frontend, transition and race scenes.
interpretation.not_supported: These framebuffer measurements alone do not establish how much of the 224-line raster a period CRT or Nintendo capture chain exposed.
interpretation.policy_consequence: Authentic logical geometry preserves all 224 rows because the centered 216-line alternative demonstrably discards rendered information. Any desired period-display edge loss belongs to optional display treatment rather than a different logical raster.
